basis_label: Dimensions and anatomical or structural basis
author: Universe Scales
note: Original botanical illustration of a representative 1 m Rafflesia arnoldii flower. Five fleshy, pale-spotted red-brown perigone lobes surround an open diaphragm and floral chamber with a central column and disk bearing processes. These anatomical relationships follow Kew, Nikolov et al. (2013) and the SIU Parasitic Plant Connection. Only the overall 1 m flower span is calibrated; lobe contours, thickness, chamber proportions, process count, bracts, colors and spot pattern are authored, not a measured specimen or scan. No leaves or independent stem are invented; the host and internal parasite are omitted.

processing.details: All other shapes, placements, surface pattern and colors are authored illustration controls, not measured data.
